### Borea v0.1.0: first release for mod authors

Borea is the community content manager for Kitten Space Agency.

This first build is intended for mod authors, not yet for all players: please list your mods in the content index and test installing, updating and launching with them.
A beta for all players follows once this has been through a few rounds.

#### What Borea does now

- Browse the content index and install mods with their dependencies, into separate instances of the game.
- Update and remove mods, and take over mods that you installed by hand.
- Mod packs, and mod lists that you can share.
- Launch through StarMap with the right instance, and say what went wrong when the game does not start.
- Play time, saves and vehicles per instance.
- A desktop app and a command line for Windows and Linux.

#### What we need from you

1. List your mod: one TOML file in a pull request to the content index, and the checks tell you when something is off. New releases on GitHub or SpaceDock are picked up on their own. The [content index guide](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains it.
2. Install your own mod through Borea and check that it lands where the game expects it.
3. Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) for quick things, [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues) for anything that you can reproduce.

#### Good to know

- The builds are not code signed yet, so Windows warns on the first start. "First start" below says what to click.
- Expect rough edges. If something looks wrong, it probably is, and we want to hear about it.
- Borea is a community project by the KSA Modding team, not made by RocketWerkz.
